summary: This is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Malcolm Licari, born 18 April 1978 in Pietà, Malta. The note calls him a retired professional footballer but also says he plays for Pietà Hotspurs, Marsaxlokk, Floriana, Balzan and Rabat Ajax in the Maltese Premier League. It describes him as a striker who occasionally plays as a defender, and says he was captain of Marsaxlokk before moving to Floriana at the end of 2011.
one_line: Malcolm Licari is a Maltese footballer born in 1978 who played as a striker for several Maltese Premier League clubs.
